about.meta.title: About VectraSyn — How We Work & FAQ
about.meta.description: Who VectraSyn is, our four-step process from discovery to support, and clear answers on cost, delivery time and post-launch support.
about.heading: We build the digital basics properly
about.story1: VectraSyn began with a simple observation: small businesses are quoted agency prices for work that should be quick, clear and affordable.
about.story2: So we kept the scope tight and the process short. Websites, apps, automation and branding — priced up front, delivered fast, and explained in plain language.
about.story3: We would rather do a small number of things properly than sell you a package you do not need.
about.process.heading: Four steps, start to finish
about.step1.title: Discover
about.step1.body: A short conversation about your business, your customers and what the project has to achieve. You leave with a fixed price and a timeline.
about.step2.title: Build
about.step2.body: We build in focused passes and share progress as we go, so nothing lands as a surprise at the end.
about.step3.title: Launch
about.step3.body: We handle setup, testing and go-live, then walk you through anything you will manage yourself.
about.step4.title: Support
about.step4.body: Optional monthly maintenance keeps everything current, or come back for one-off changes whenever you need them.
about.hybrid.label: Hybrid working:

about.faq.heading: Common questions
about.faq.q1: How much does a website cost?
about.faq.a1short: A standard business website is ₹18,000 (about $350 / AED 1,500) at our current price.
about.faq.a1long: That covers a multi-section, mobile-friendly site built and launched for you. Larger scopes — extra pages, e-commerce, custom integrations — are quoted individually. The full menu, including bundles and other currencies, is on the pricing page.
about.faq.a2short: Most small-business websites go live within one to two weeks.
about.faq.a2long: Logo design and single automation pipelines are usually quicker; app builds take longer and depend on scope. You get a specific timeline with your quote, before any work begins.
about.faq.q3: Do you offer support after launch?
about.faq.a3short: Yes — monthly maintenance is available at ₹8,000 per month.
about.faq.a3long: Maintenance covers updates, fixes and small content or design changes. It is entirely optional; you can also come back for one-off changes whenever you need them.
about.faq.q4: What do you need from me to get started?
about.faq.a4short: A short description of your business and what you want the project to achieve.
about.faq.a4long: Anything you already have helps — logo files, photos, text, or links to sites you like. If none of that exists yet, we work through it together during discovery.
about.faq.q5: Do you work with businesses outside India?
about.faq.a5short: Yes — we work remotely and quote in INR, USD and AED.
about.faq.a5long: Communication runs over email and video calls, on a schedule agreed around your time zone.
